name: Baserow Cloud
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Baserow Cloud, use a managed open-source database workspace with grids, forms, and views. The hard boundary is managed hosting, upgrades, backups, collaboration, and premium features, plus data model flexibility, collaboration, and integrations.
